knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Diagnosis is outside the service. The tutor refers the family.
Enrolment and parent or guardian consent are recorded before the first session.
Results are not guaranteed. Goals are about skills and practice.

practicalCriteria: Assessor presents an out-of-scope request and observes the candidate decline, refer and record it
Assessor checks the enrolment form for parent or guardian consent before a session is booked
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate. Child-safety content needs a reviewer before approval.
evidenceRequired: Recorded decline with reason and date
stopWorkCriteria: The candidate gives a diagnosis or a guaranteed result
The candidate starts a session with a learner under 18 before consent is recorded
